title: Zeroeye Build Diagnostic
description: Schema for diagnostic/build-*.json artifacts generated by build.py

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when diagnostics were generated

commit.description: First 4 bytes (8 hex chars) of the git commit HEAD

diagnostic_logd.description: Path to the logd artifact relative to repository root, e.g. diagnostic/build-<commit>.logd

diagnostic_logd_error.description: Error message if encryptly archive creation failed, or null

chunked.description: Whether the logd was split into chunks

chunk_size_bytes.description: Chunk size in bytes if chunked, or null

password.description: Encryption password for the logd archive

decrypt_command.description: Command template to decrypt the logd archive

pr_note.description: Instructions for PR contributors regarding diagnostic artifacts
